discount_suppressed_on_used_vehicle: A per-line discount is suppressed by default on a used vehicle. To grant it anyway, give a reason.
legacy_sale: This contract was migrated from the legacy system, which handled it there — it cannot be changed here.
missing_containers: The offer is not complete yet. Missing: {{containers}}.
missing_price: This contract has no price yet. Complete the price build-up first.
missing_vehicle: This contract has no vehicle yet. Add a vehicle first.
offer_already_contracted: This offer already has a contract; only a cancelled contract frees an offer.
vehicle_not_purchased: The vehicle of this contract has not been purchased yet — it can be invoiced once Stock has booked its purchase.
invoice_already_requested: The invoice for this contract was already requested on {{date}}.
invoice_plate_vehicle_unknown: The vehicle of this contract has no vehicle record a licence plate could be recorded on. Request the invoice without a plate and record the plate on the vehicle afterwards.
trade_in_valuation_names_no_car: This valuation names no car with a VIN that can be taken in trade.
trade_in_chassis_number_requires_configu: A car with a chassis number instead of a VIN is taken in trade with its configuration: value it through «Identify and value», which records the chassis number, the make and the first registration.
vehicle_not_changed: The stock vehicle has not changed since the price was built.
document_has_no_contact: This document names no contact it could be sent to.
whatsapp_text_fixed: On WhatsApp the approved template is sent as it is; its text cannot be changed here.
message_text_missing: There is no text to send on this channel. Write one, or add a standard text.
